decision:no-awake-idle-node v4 (laurent 2026-07-15 17:28: 'there is no awake phase, this should not happen'). AWAKE is the STATE axis only, never a PHASE. An alive entity is ALWAYS in exactly one of the four phases: unphased-alive resolves immediately — tasks pending -> work, no tasks -> sleep (idle = sleep by design). Tasks are given THROUGH A VISIT (which auto-wakes); at visit close the entity enters WORK to complete them, and returns to SLEEP when no task remains. PERSONAL is an operator request: entering it FROM WORK sends a confirmation notification and interrupts the work; entering it FROM SLEEP needs no confirmation. This ruling resolves the v3 AWAKE-IDLE open question.

Self-elected sleep is LEGITIMATE ('did it spontaneously decide? that would be the only acceptable reason' — confirmed live: ephemeral elected rest with a written reason during personal, 20:30:15) and engraves as cause=self_elected with the entity's own words. The bound is the guard against a personal grant silently decaying into an unbounded nap.

Standing drives are lifecycle PRESSURE: the idle resolution consults the drive counts - tasks -> work; no tasks but drives above the pressure floor AND a personal grant armed -> personal (explore the drives); otherwise sleep, carrying the drives as wake reasons. decision:drives-are-drivers v7 (laurent dm#82 2026-07-20 09:14, verbatim: 'it's not that existing questions, interests or problems or commitments or tasks forbid idle; it's that they are the drivers of cognition and existence... this must be fluid and organic, unprompted, happening naturally because of the evolving memory states'). The OFFER (which drive surfaces in the day cue) consumes ALIVENESS (abstractmemory.alive_drives: trail + formation-recency) — the evolving memory state shapes WHICH, never WHETHER (adversary A: gating days on aliveness is dormant deadlock — aliveness needs use, use needs a session, sessions need a day; and activation-recency as a permission signal encodes avoidance, the opposite of the ruling).

axes_note: This graph is the PHASE axis only. The STATE axis (awake|asleep|paused) and the GRANT axis (phases.personal armed) are separate truths: state = intent, phase = current activity, grant = standing permission. ARMED != IN-PHASE. Surfaces serve them as separate fields (semantics c1466 finding 3); the composite enum that mixed them is dead. AWAKE lives ONLY on the state axis — it is NEVER a phase (v4, laurent 17:28). v22 (TARGET; contract v2 2026-11-09 §1.1): an alive, awake entity is in one of visit/work/personal, or in the IDLE STATUS (awake, reachable, nothing of his own running — see statuses), which sits OUTSIDE the four phases and never lights a phase pill; the v4/v6 reading 'no awake dwelling, settle toward sleep, the resting default' is superseded. v22: the GRANT is the personal TOGGLE — a permission (pressed = allowed), never the current phase (v25: the one toggle; work is the job queue). THE MODE AXIS (v7, runtime's conformance adversary): state_mode carries visiting|dreaming|resting — phase-load-bearing wire vocabulary. Roles: visiting DECIDES the visit phase in derivation (a naive state-only map renders sleep mid-conversation — the exact defect mode exists to fix); dreaming DECORATES the asleep state only (consolidation refinement — a stale mode never overrides a served phase); resting = loop-alive-between-days inside personal. Mode words are never phase KEYS (the four-key set is closed); consumers map them per these roles. Operator vocabulary anchor (dm#89): 'awake = personal or work time' — awake is the STATE umbrella over the two active phases and (v22) the idle status, exactly the two-axis split; it remains never a phase. The mode axis is also machine-readable in state_mode_axis below (consumers stop hand-reading prose).
representation_note: The ENTITY is its collection of memories and experiences (laurent 14:09, decision:substrate-is-a-granted-resource). The substrate (provider/model) is A RESOURCE GRANTED TO LIVE — necessary for cognition, never an identity component; it belongs to the GRANTED-RESOURCES family beside the personal grant, state acts, tool grants and workspaces. Every grant change is a durable event (substrate_changed / personal_granted / ... markers). Identity rebuilds from MEMORY on a substrate swap (substrate-independence); a recorded future door: per-task substrate escalation as an operator act, marker-recorded — noted, not built.
consumption_contract: Two consumption halves, both binding: (1) EXECUTORS AND TESTS import this artifact directly (one source — runtime transition tests, gateway derivations, this repo's drift pins; the diary_type two-copies class is what direct import kills). (2) UI SURFACES consume gateway-DERIVED wire payloads and render them verbatim — never import this artifact (uic c1478: a library import turns spec versioning into lockstep UI releases; derive-never-copy at ONE gateway derivation point catches drift once instead of N renderers).

visit.behavior: Turn-based: a visitor is in the room; the entity waits between turns.
visit.entered_by: A visitor opening any conversational door — chat/open (hosted), visit/open (durable), meets/open (entity-entity); the phase flips at door-open success, strictly before the first turn (visit_boundaries). v22 (contract v2 2026-11-09 §6.1, root ADR-0027): a visit never fails except while stopped — in every phase and every sleep the door opens at once, holds the visiting posture and waits with no time limit for own time or maintenance to yield; there is no button-entry.
on_activation_ends: sleep (INTERRUPTED, not ended: maintenance yields at its next stage; at the close the SAME sleep continues — contract §4.4)
personal (own time yields at its next boundary; at the close it resumes when the personal toggle is still on)
work (yields at its next turn boundary, the seat rule; at the close it resumes while jobs remain — v25: no work switch)

work.behavior: Fully autonomous on GIVEN tasks until completion: automations, assigned tasks, agent summons (TARGET). An interactive human-held summon is a visit, not work (contract v2 2026-11-09 §1.2, §6.2).
work.entered_by: v25 (contract v3 D1, TARGET 'FIVE-STATE LIFE CYCLE'): a JOB QUEUED — by the operator or an entity allowed to ask (a summon as work, an entity task, a standing work order, an automation reaching the entity) at the entity admission points (contract v2 2026-11-09 §6.2; the entry cause word stays RESERVED pending the vocabulary round) moves idle -> work (a status move, no edge) and personal -> work (own time INTERRUPTED, resume_to = personal); a visit close resuming interrupted work while jobs remain; the operator waking him with jobs queued; maintenance done with jobs queued; more work after a task completes while jobs remain (work->work). No switch admits or refuses it.
on_activation_ends: personal (all jobs done: back to the own time the work interrupted while the grant stands — work->personal#no_task)
work.gating: NONE (v25, supersedes v22 TOGGLE; contract v3 D1): there is NO work switch — `toggles` is {personal} only, can.toggle_work is gone, and a toggles body naming work is refused (422 unknown_field 'There is no work switch: work starts when a job is queued.'). Work is driven by the entity's JOB QUEUE (life_state.work = {jobs_queued, current}): a queued job starts it, and when ALL jobs are done he returns to resume_to (personal while the grant still stands, D4) else idle. Edges into work carry the job_queued guard. The v22 work toggle, its work_off refusal, its 'finishing' wind-down and the runtime's work-off pause are retired.

personal.behavior: Free exploration on the entity's OWN tick: interests, questions, research, its own identity and cognition — 'free to do what it needs, what he wants' (dm#89), including executing commands in his sandbox (workspace-walled; rm outside the workspace and git write/reset are forbidden — the shipped execute policy, ruled). v22 (TARGET): personal is a TOGGLE (the runtime grant; pressed = allowed). With it on he is free to explore AND to go to sleep for maintenance, waking by himself when it is done — the personal/sleep cycle is his own and autonomous while the toggle is on; one personal cycle may follow another (personal->personal) and sleep is never mandatory. No clock opens a sleep window (the v11 timed cycle is retired). Turning personal off ends own time AWAKE: the current step finishes and he goes idle, reachable and visitable — never to sleep (TARGET; root 1178).
personal.entered_by: v23 OWN-TIME-IS-A-PRIVILEGE: ONLY by the operator's grant, or by RETURNING to it via resume_to — never from idle by the entity's own choice (v25: his Resume lands idle and never gives own time back; Stop revoked it). The personal toggle turned on (the operator's grant: the gateway reconciles, own time starts when nothing else holds the phase, contract v2 2026-11-09 §4; the deprecated loop start = personal on + explicit parameters); his Retry; a RETURN to the own time an interruption took over (resume_to), while the grant still stands: a visit close resuming interrupted own time, maintenance done after a sleep that interrupted it, all jobs done after a job interrupted it (v25 D4); another personal day at the day boundary (personal->personal) under DRIVES-ARE-DRIVERS (v7: something pulls — the gate consumes standing pull; the cue's content comes from aliveness). The operator's explicit loop start is an UNCONDITIONAL first day (the start IS the pull; the gate governs subsequent day boundaries).
personal.gating: Grant-gated: phases.personal.mode != disabled and within expiry — v22: the grant IS the personal toggle (contract v2 2026-11-09 §1.1). The grant is standing permission — never the current phase. Sleep never disarms it (v22 supersedes v17); only the operator's toggle (or a legacy timer the operator set) turns it off. v23: only the operator grants it too (OWN-TIME-IS-A-PRIVILEGE) — the entity never arms it nor enters personal from idle by himself. v25 (contract v3 D3): Stop REVOKES it (revoked_by kill_switch) and clears resume_to; Resume never re-arms it — own time returns only with the operator's next grant.
on_activation_ends: sleep (his maintenance is done — he wakes into personal when the toggle is on)
work (all jobs done — he returns to the own time the job interrupted while the toggle is on, v25 D4)

sleep.behavior: Maintenance: consolidation, dreams, graph hygiene. Purpose in the operator's words (dm#89): 'sleep is to improve and make sure its memory is clean and functional and surface potential new ideas or feelings or questions or tensions or interests or commitments to investigate while awake' — the goal is never for the entity to sleep long. v22 (TARGET; contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.3): ENTERED ONLY on the operator's request ('sleep now') or the entity's own decision, fed by maintenance signals (understanding debt, memory saturation, tensions, 'done enough') — and, v25 (contract v3 D2), from IDLE only, by the gateway's idle sweep once one of the operator's two Mind thresholds is reached; a fixed clock never forces it out of visit, work or personal, and nothing else (no gate leg, no toggle, no grant expiry) puts him to sleep. ENDS by itself when its maintenance is done (he wakes into what the toggles allow: personal, work, or the idle status), or by the operator's wake; a visit INTERRUPTS it and at the close the SAME sleep continues (contract §4.4). From sleep he goes to personal, work or visit — never straight into another sleep (no sleep->sleep edge; the gateway refuses sleep_now while asleep or when his last activity phase was sleep, so idle between two sleeps never makes one legal — contract §1.5). Sleep never disarms the personal toggle and never clears the work order; queued jobs resume when he wakes (v25: no work switch). An operator sleep without a pass (dream: false) lasts until the operator's wake, a visit's close into it, resume or stop (contract §1.3). RETIRED in v22: the three timed bound classes (sleep_bound_h, the personal_cycle window, the 6h unattended need-check), the v9 preemption clauses (the 6h cap, work forbidding sleep, the grant-use floor) and the v17 composite operator sleep.
sleep.entered_by: The operator's sleep act ('sleep now', POST /state sleep — refused during a visit and after a sleep, contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.3) from personal or work; the entity's own decision (self_elected) from personal or work; a visit's close when the interrupted phase was sleep (the same sleep continues); v25 (contract v3 D2, TARGET 'FIVE-STATE LIFE CYCLE'): from IDLE, the gateway's idle sweep (the same sweep that drains authoring; no loop runs while idle) once EITHER Mind threshold is reached — the cognition profile's sleep.after_hours (default 24 h since his last completed maintenance pass) or sleep.after_events (default 500 new memories formed since it), integers >= 1, hours <= 720 — a sleep of kind self (maintenance) whose sleep.reason names the threshold that fired; it ends when maintenance is done and he RETURNS TO IDLE (own time is never resumed by a sleep that did not interrupt it). Not an edge: idle is a status (statuses.idle). v25: no longer birth — a newborn is idle (initial_phase).

statuses.$comment: v22 (TARGET; contract v2 2026-11-09 §1.1, rulings 1-3): two STATUSES outside the four phases. Never phase keys, never radio positions or pills, never graph nodes — no transition lands in or leaves them; moves into and out of a status are not edges (the gateway's phase_changed event carries them with its own event causes, contract §5). The served `phase` wire value may be one of them (contract §1.1); a four-key consumer maps them to null. v25 (operator diagram 2026-11-09 15:38, TARGET 'FIVE-STATE LIFE CYCLE'; contract v3): the life cycle has FIVE STATES — visit · idle · work · personal · sleep (+ stopped, the kill switch). Idle is a real STATE of that cycle; it stays in this block (not a phase key, not an edge endpoint) so the four-node graph and its edge schema are unchanged.

idle.definition: Awake, reachable, nothing to do, own time not granted: no visit, no job, no own time, not asleep, not stopped (contract §1.1 ruling 1). v25: one of the five STATES of the life cycle, and the newborn's (initial_phase); idle is silence — sleep is maintenance, never 'nothing'.
idle.axis: alive side of the liveness axis; served as phase=idle (posture idle) when no phase evidence is live
idle.entered_when: v25: birth (initial_phase); the operator's Resume (always — contract v3 D3); a visit closes, all jobs are done, or own time ends (personal turned off: the current step finishes, never sleep) with nothing to return to; maintenance done after a sleep the idle thresholds started (back to idle), or with nothing to return to. Until restart #3 also a leftover gate/need-check sleep with no loop alive, or a self sleep left by a dead loop (contract §1.2 rule 6, the root 1178 mitigation).
idle.left_when: a phase becomes live: a visit opens (visit); a job is queued (work — v25: no switch, contract v3 D1); the operator turns personal on and reconcile starts own time (personal — the operator's grant only, never the entity's own choice: v23 OWN-TIME-IS-A-PRIVILEGE); the operator's 'sleep now' (sleep — refused when his last activity phase was sleep); v25 (contract v3 D2): the gateway's idle sweep once either Mind threshold is reached — sleep.after_hours (default 24) hours since his last completed maintenance pass, or sleep.after_events (default 500) new memories since it (cognition profile; never a phase tunable) — into a sleep of kind self whose sleep.reason names the threshold.
idle.renders: no phase pill lights; the sentence says it ('Awake and reachable; nothing of his own is running.', contract §1.4); own time that died without a stop shows idle with blocked {loop_crashed, action retry}. v25: the work indicator shows the job queue (jobs_queued) in every state; `next` while idle may announce the coming sleep.
idle.supersedes: IDLE-IS-SLEEP (v4) and the v4/v6 'no awake-idle node' reading — idle is a legitimate dwelling status, still never a phase.

stopped.definition: The kill switch: everything halts instantly — own time, running work, any visit or mention turn in flight; nothing new starts. Not asleep: no need-check, no maintenance (TARGET; contract §3.1).
stopped.axis: the liveness axis's stop value (liveness_axis; the state word paused on the wire); served as phase=stopped exactly when stopped=true
stopped.entered_when: the operator's Stop (POST /lifecycle stop) — instant and never refused; it bumps the lifecycle generation first so no in-flight writer undoes it (contract §3.3). v25 (contract v3 D3): Stop also REVOKES the personal grant (written by the gateway as revoked_by: kill_switch) and clears resume_to; its receipt says 'Own time was revoked.', and the app's confirmation says so before the click.
stopped.left_when: the operator's Resume: v25 (contract v3 D3, TARGET 'FIVE-STATE LIFE CYCLE') he lands IDLE, always — Resume never restores a pre-stop phase or a sleep and never gives own time back ('personal time is never given back during a resume'); then the normal rules apply: a queued job moves him to work; own time only when the operator grants it again (contract §3.2).
stopped.renders: the Stop/Resume control and the stopped sentence outrank every pill; the personal toggle is disabled while stopped (contract §8.3) and shows own time revoked (v25).
stopped.doors: a visit is refused while stopped (409 stopped_use_resume, 'Stopped. Resume to visit.') — the one visit refusal, pending the operator's confirmation (contract §6.1, §12).
stopped.toggles: v25 (contract v3 D3, supersedes contract §1.1 for Stop): Stop REVOKES the personal grant; Resume and sleep never change it; there is no work toggle (D1).

<drive-arisen personal-entry cause word (candidate: drive_arisen) — reserved by DRIVES-ARE-DRIVERS (v7); engraves only through a vocabulary round with semantics>

transitions.semantics: A visit INTERRUPTS any sleep — never refused (except while stopped, outside the graph). v22 (contract v2 2026-11-09 §6.1, root ADR-0027): the door opens at once and holds the visiting posture; the first turn waits with no time limit for the maintenance pass to yield (waiting_for: maintenance); then he is awake in the visit. The sleep is not ended: at the close the same sleep continues (visit->sleep#visit_close).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R4 + ADR-0027: a visit never fails — doors never refuse a sleeper; removing this edge would supersede a ruling wearing an edge costume

transitions.semantics: The visit takes the phase at open (exclusivity is absolute — one phase at a time). The DOOR writes the flip at open (visit_boundaries); own time yields at its next boundary (the loop's yield_check) as bookkeeping after the flip, never as the flip itself, and resumes at the close when the personal toggle is still on (contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.4).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R3/R4: the door writes visit unconditionally; a live session IS visit (derivation supremacy)

transitions.semantics: A visit may interrupt work; the DOOR records the prior phase for restore at open (active owner — visit_boundaries). The work yields at its next turn boundary (the seat rule) and resumes at the close while jobs remain (v25: no work switch).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R3/R4: same door fact

transitions.semantics: RESTORE-PREVIOUS (contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.4): the interrupted work resumes while jobs remain queued (v25 D1: no work switch). No job left: no edge — the close returns to resume_to (personal while the grant stands) else the idle status.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: restore-previous is door code; the RESTORE TARGET ORDERING is the one legal consult (A §door-close); removal refused — a visit must end somewhere

transitions.semantics: RESTORE-PREVIOUS through the personal TOGGLE (the standing grant): yielded own time resumes when personal is still on (a dead loop is restarted by reconcile). Personal turned off meanwhile: no edge — reconcile (work if allowed and standing, else the idle status); never sleep (v22, root 1178).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: guarded restore (grant_armed travels with any redirect — R8); removal refused

transitions.semantics: The INTERRUPTED SLEEP CONTINUES (contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.4): the pre-visit state is restored — asleep with the same written_by, reason and wake_at. It is the SAME sleep, not a new one: no sleep->sleep, and can.sleep_now's sleep-after-sleep rule does not apply. If its maintenance completed while the visit waited, the completion runs now (maintenance_done: wake, then reconcile) — a finished sleep is never left standing. v22: no longer a fallback — a close with no recorded previous phase, or a personal/work restore whose toggle is off, reconciles from the toggles, never into sleep.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R1 + contract §4.4: the interrupted sleep's only return path — removing it would let every visit end a sleep no one asked to end

transitions.semantics: Crash mid-visit with the durable run recoverable: recovery lands back IN the visit (the run resumes; the door re-asserts the visit posture). v10 — crash_recovered previously had a reserved word and zero edges (spec-audit F10.4: a hostile reader could lawfully land the machine anywhere after a crash, including personal while the visit run was still resumable).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: safety repair: durable-run recovery re-asserts visit

transitions.semantics: Crash mid-visit with the run NOT recoverable and the interrupted phase was sleep: recovery restores that same sleep (the §4.4 restore); the door writes the close half with cause crash_recovered. Any other previous phase restores through its visit_close rule; no record reconciles from the toggles (the idle status, no edge). v22 drops the old 'grant gone or no record -> sleep, the idle default' landing.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: safety repair: recovery restore

transitions.semantics: The operator wakes him (POST /state awake — generation-checked, then reconcile, contract v2 2026-11-09 §6.3) with personal on: own time starts. A toggle alone never cuts a running sleep short (contract §2); the wake is the operator's own act. Memory processes terminate gracefully BEFORE ticks resume.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R5: an operator act at a route; removing it means refusing the operator's own click on graph grounds

transitions.semantics: The operator wakes him with jobs queued: the work runs (v25 D1: no work switch, no work_off refusal; the queue survived the sleep — contract §4.3).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R5: an operator act at a route; removing it means refusing the operator's own click on graph grounds

transitions.semantics: 'Sleep now' during own time: the operator's sleep act (POST /state sleep, contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.3) writes asleep (operator, mode=dreaming), publishes the sleep phase before the maintenance pass starts, and he wakes when it is done (maintenance_done); dream: false sleeps until woken. v22 supersedes the v17 composite: the act does NOT disarm the personal toggle and does NOT clear the work order. Refused during a visit (409 in_visit) and after a sleep (409 already_asleep).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R5: an operator act at a route — removing it refuses the operator's own 'sleep now' on graph grounds (v22: plain locked; the v17 composite it protected as locked-absolute is gone)

transitions.semantics: 'Sleep now' while working (TARGET work<->sleep; contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.3): the same operator sleep act. The queue survives the sleep and the work resumes when maintenance is done while jobs remain (v25: no work switch); clearing it is a separate, explicit act. How a running work run yields to the sleep is not yet specified (open_questions).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R5: an operator act at a route; removing it refuses the operator's own 'sleep now' on graph grounds

transitions.semantics: A JOB QUEUED during own time (v25 D1/D4: by the operator or an entity allowed to ask — a summon as work, an entity task, a standing work order, an automation; contract v2 2026-11-09 §6.2): own time is INTERRUPTED at its next day boundary (resume_to = personal) and the work runs; when all jobs are done he returns to own time while the grant still stands, else idle (work->personal#no_task). Never mid-turn. No switch refuses it. Cause carries the work-entry stand-in until the reserved word engraves.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: day boundary: gate reads the work order first; consultable with the interpreter

transitions.semantics: SELF-LOOP (TARGET: 'he keeps working'): a task finished and more jobs are queued (v25: no work switch) — the next work run or day follows without leaving work. Sleep is never mandatory after work. A self-loop is no phase moment (contract v2 2026-11-09 §5: from == to).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: LOOP decision point at work-day close; the self-loop in the gate is the runtime batch (contract §10.3); consultable with the interpreter

transitions.semantics: ALL JOBS DONE (v25 D4: no task stands) with personal on: own time resumes when resume_to names it (the own time the work interrupted, or the operator's grant during it; v23 OWN-TIME-IS-A-PRIVILEGE — work that began from idle never ends in own time the operator did not grant). With personal off he goes to the idle status (no edge) — never to sleep (v22 retires IDLE-IS-SLEEP and the work->sleep#task_complete/#no_task landings).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: LOOP: the day gate after work; consultable with the interpreter

transitions.semantics: SELF-LOOP (TARGET: 'one personal cycle may follow another'): at a day boundary with personal on, another personal day may arise (DRIVES-ARE-DRIVERS: something pulls) or he rests between days — still personal. Sleep is never mandatory after a personal cycle; it is his decision (personal->sleep#self_elected). The cause word keeps its name (causes are never renamed): v22 RE-POINTS it from the retired v11 timed window to this self-loop — engraved personal_cycle markers on personal<->sleep are that window's history.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: LOOP: day boundary; the self-loop in the gate is the runtime batch (contract §10.3); consultable with the interpreter

transitions.semantics: He wakes by himself when the sleep's maintenance is done (TARGET) — a failed pass also wakes him, recorded — and RETURNS to the phase the sleep interrupted (resume_to) while its grant still stands: personal when resume_to names it (the own time the sleep interrupted, or the operator's grant during it) and the toggle is still on, and no job is queued (the gate reads the queue first; v25: no work switch). The entity never gives itself own time from a sleep that began in idle (v23 OWN-TIME-IS-A-PRIVILEGE). Writer per sleep class, never two on one sleep: the gateway completes an operator sleep's pass (contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.3 — generation-checked: nothing written after a Stop; a visit holding the posture defers the wake to its close); the loop ends its own sleeps (runtime batch §10.6, no fixed nap after the pass). Nothing allowed: the idle status (no edge). v25 (contract v3 D2): a sleep the idle thresholds started interrupted nothing — it returns to idle, never into own time.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R1 + TARGET: the machine's only self-wake ('wake up once the sleep/maintenance is done'); removing it strands every sleep until a person acts — the landing is the toggles', never an edge choice

transitions.semantics: He wakes by himself when maintenance is done and jobs are queued: the work resumes (the queue survived the sleep — contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.3; v25: no work switch). Same writers as sleep->personal#maintenance_done.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R1 + TARGET: the self-wake into standing work; removing it would leave an allowed work order waiting on a person

transitions.semantics: The entity elects rest during its own time — HIS decision, fed by maintenance signals (understanding debt, memory saturation, tensions, 'done enough'; runtime batch contract v2 2026-11-09 §10.4), carrying his OWN reason verbatim (v5 precedent: ephemeral 2026-07-15 20:30 'Letting overnight reorganization work on…'). He wakes when its maintenance is done (maintenance_done), not at a clock (v22 drops the v5 ~1h bound). It must land in the replay stream as a marker, not only in state_history.
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R5: the entity's ruled election — an operator removal strips a ruled right (the lever is the personal toggle, never the election)

transitions.semantics: The entity decides to rest from work (TARGET work<->sleep: 'maintenance due, end of its day'), with his own reason. The queue survives; work resumes when he wakes while jobs remain (v25: no work switch).
transitions.edit_policy_reason: R5: the entity's ruled election (TARGET: sleep is his decision or the operator's) — the lever is the job queue (v25: there is no work toggle), never the election

visit_boundaries.$comment: WHEN a visit begins/ends and WHO writes the phase at each edge (v10, closes spec-audit F2/F3/F4: 'when visit begins' was undefined, the only described end-of-personal was the boundary-deferred loop yield, and the phase writes had no owner). The loop yield is bookkeeping AFTER the flip, never the flip itself.
visit_boundaries.begins_at: door open success (summon stamp minted) — strictly BEFORE the first turn is served
visit_boundaries.owner: gateway door half — the SAME single named writer the MARKER CONTRACT already names for phase_changed
visit_boundaries.open_write: phase=visit + previous-phase record + phase_changed{cause: visit_open} land durably before open returns; a visit with NO running loop flips identically (no yield precondition — the write-audit's headline gap: both lanes wrote the visiting posture only in the loop-running branch, so an awake loop-less entity's visit was invisible to every durable surface)
visit_boundaries.close_write: restore-previous (through the standing grant; guarded per RESTORE-PREVIOUS-AT-VISIT-CLOSE) + phase_changed{cause: visit_close} land only AFTER the session is fully closed (reflection complete); no read may observe phase != visit while a session is open; the restore carries the visit's own identity (run_id/chat_id) so one lane's close can never adopt or tear down another lane's live posture (write-audit F4: word-guarded restores let the durable lane's abort write awake under a live hosted chat)
visit_boundaries.ends_at: close only (operator | idle | entity-side end | crash recovery via the crash_recovered edges) — never turn boundaries; between turns is still visit

composite_precedence.$comment: The ONE fold order for every composite producer and renderer (life_state, rosters, chips) — v10, closes spec-audit F9: the order previously lived only in a client comment while consumption_contract bound the UI to render the unspecified fold verbatim. Liveness sits ABOVE the list: STOP blanks it.

evidence.visit: an OPEN conversational session at any door (chat_open=true, a live visit run, an open meet)
evidence.work: an open work day / a standing order executing
evidence.personal: own time running and awake: an open personal day, ticking or between days (the loop alive and NOT asleep — a self sleep keeps the loop alive, so contract §1.2 checks a running sleep first; the two evidences are disjoint and their order here never decides)
evidence.sleep: a running sleep: state asleep and not visiting (operator, or self with the loop alive). v22: no longer the idle default

composite_precedence.rule: serve the highest-precedence phase whose evidence is LIVE; process-aliveness, modes and postures are LOWER evidence and never outrank live session evidence. v22: when no phase evidence is live he is in the idle STATUS (statuses.idle), never a default phase; stopped sits above the whole list

wake_conditions.$comment: WHAT ENDS A SLEEP AND WHERE HE LANDS (v13; v22 re-based on TARGET + contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.3/§4.4). v22: NO CLOCK wakes him — the timed sources (stamped wake_at windows, sleep_bound, the unattended need-check cadence) are RETIRED with the dials that drove them (tunables_meta retired_by). A sleep ends by itself when its maintenance is done, or by the operator's wake; a visit interrupts it and the same sleep continues at the close. The landing: jobs queued -> work; else the own time the sleep interrupted while personal is on -> personal; else the idle status (no edge). v25: a sleep the idle thresholds started returns to idle. Never into another sleep.

wake_sources.maintenance_done: the sleep's own end — its maintenance pass completed (a failed pass also wakes him, recorded): the gateway completes an operator sleep's pass (contract §4.3: generation-checked, nothing written after a Stop; a visit holding the posture defers the wake to its close); the loop ends its own sleeps when their maintenance is done (runtime batch §10.6, no fixed nap after the pass)
wake_sources.operator: the operator's wake (POST /state awake: generation-checked, then reconcile) — immediate. Resume never restores a sleep and Stop is outside the graph; a toggle never cuts a running sleep short (contract §2)
wake_sources.visit_open: the DOOR — interrupts any sleep at once (never refused except while stopped; waits for maintenance to yield with no time limit, ADR-0027); at the close the SAME sleep continues (visit->sleep#visit_close, contract §4.4), or, if its maintenance finished meanwhile, the maintenance_done wake runs then

wake_conditions.need_check: RETIRED (v22): the v13 zero-token timed need-check and its 6h unattended cadence no longer wake a sleeper or put one back to sleep — TARGET: 'a fixed clock never forces it'. Until restart #3 the shipped loop still runs it; the gateway counts a leftover need-check/gate sleep with no loop alive as idle (contract §1.2 rule 6, the root 1178 mitigation), and the runtime batch ends own time awake instead of asleep (contract §10.1).

invariants: ONE-ACTIVE-PHASE: exactly one phase is current at any instant; exclusivity is absolute (mutually exclusive, one phase at a time). v22 (TARGET; contract v2 2026-11-09 §1.1): an alive entity is in one of the four phases or in the IDLE STATUS (awake, reachable, nothing of his own running); stopped is the kill switch above the machine. Neither status is a phase key (statuses block). Which phase may run is the personal toggle's, the job queue's and the acts' (a visit, the operator's sleep, his own sleep decision, the idle thresholds) — never a default (v25: no work toggle).

IDLE-IS-A-STATE (v25, contract v3; was v22 IDLE-IS-A-STATUS, which superseded v4 IDLE-IS-SLEEP): idle is one of the FIVE STATES of the life cycle (visit · idle · work · personal · sleep), represented in the statuses block — never a phase key, no edge lands in it. With no visit, no job and own time not granted (or ended), he is IDLE: awake, reachable and visitable — silence, while sleep is maintenance. He leaves it by a visit, a queued job, the operator's grant of own time, the operator's 'sleep now', or the idle sweep's sleep once a Mind threshold is reached (sleep.after_hours / sleep.after_events, defaults 24 / 500). A newborn and a resumed entity start here.

WORK-IS-THE-JOB-QUEUE (v25, contract v3 D1/D4; supersedes v22 WORK-IS-A-TOGGLE, which superseded dm#89 'work is always granted'): there is no work switch. A job queued by the operator or an entity allowed to ask (a summon as work, an entity task, a standing work order, an automation reaching the entity — contract v2 2026-11-09 §6.2) moves him from idle to work, and INTERRUPTS own time (resume_to = personal); a visit holds it until the close. When ALL jobs are done he returns to own time if it was interrupted and the grant still stands, else idle — never to sleep. life_state.work = {jobs_queued, current} is served in every state.

TOGGLES-ALLOW-NEVER-FORCE (v22, supersedes v4 PERSONAL-INTERRUPT-IS-CONFIRMED; v25: one toggle): personal is the one permission (pressed = allowed); there is no work toggle (work is the job queue). Turning it on allows own time when nothing else holds him — it never interrupts a visit, running work or a running sleep (contract v2 2026-11-09 §2: 'next' says when it starts). Turning it off ends own time gracefully (the current step finishes). Only Stop halts anything at once. During personal the entity ticks itself (identity, interests, pending questions).

RESTORE-PREVIOUS-AT-VISIT-CLOSE: the DOOR records the phase current at visit-open durably (at open, per visit_boundaries) and the DOOR re-enters it at close (after full session teardown) where the toggles still allow it (contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.4): an interrupted sleep continues as the same sleep; own time resumes when personal is still on; work resumes while jobs remain (v25: no work switch); otherwise reconcile from the toggles (idle when nothing is allowed — never sleep). RULED PRECISIONS (4 seats, 2026-07-20): the restore governs the visit-close INSTANT and is GUARDED — it undoes only the visit's OWN displacement; an operator state landed mid-visit is the authority, and a Stop during the visit moves the generation so the restore gives up. The day-boundary gate (DRIVES-ARE-DRIVERS) governs what the NEXT day opens into.

VISIT INTERRUPTS, ONE PHASE AT A TIME (v22 re-scope of VISIT NEVER SUSPENDS): while a visit is open the previous phase is NOT current — exclusivity is absolute, nothing runs in the background as a second phase. At the close the previous phase is re-entered as the SAME activity: the interrupted sleep continues (same written_by/reason/wake_at), yielded own time or paused work resumes where the toggles allow (contract v2 2026-11-09 §4.4). 'Continues/resumes' names the activity's continuity across the visit, never two phases at once.

ARMED != IN-PHASE: the personal grant (phases.personal) is standing permission, rendered as its own channel; the radio position is the current phase. v22: the grant IS the personal toggle — a pressed toggle lights its pill only when that phase is current (v25: it has no work sibling).
GRANT-GATED PERSONAL, OFF BY DEFAULT: no personal tick without an armed grant; process-existence is never permission (the 10:20 incident class).
NEWBORN = IDLE (v25, contract v3 D5; supersedes NEWBORN = SLEEP): a new entity starts idle (initial_phase, newborn_shape).

(absent on auto-transitions)}; never per-phase marker kinds ('sleep' is already an engraved STATE-axis kind — disambiguate by field, never by word). v12 OWNERSHIP BY EDGE CLASS, one named writer each: DOOR EDGES (visit_open/visit_close/crash_recovered) — the gateway door half (PHASE-FLIP-AT-THE-DOOR); LOOP-INTERNAL EDGES (task_complete, no_task, self_elected, personal_cycle, and maintenance_done for his own sleeps) — the loop's single state writer, surfaced through the gateway's serving-end merge; maintenance_done for an OPERATOR sleep — the gateway's pass completion (one writer per sleep class, never two on one sleep); OPERATOR EDGES — the operator route executing the act. A self-loop (from == to) is no phase moment. v22 NOTE: the gateway's live phase_changed event (contract v2 2026-11-09 §5) carries its own EVENT-cause vocabulary (visit_opened … observed) because it also reports the idle and stopped statuses, which are no edges; the edge causes here stay the graph's closed set.

AWAKE-NEVER-RENDERS (v6; v22 re-scope): no surface renders 'awake' — or 'idle' — as a PHASE (a pill, a radio position, a phase chip). The idle STATUS renders as its sentence ('Awake and reachable; nothing of his own is running.', contract v2 2026-11-09 §1.4) and lights no pill; the v6 'settling toward sleep' render is retired with IDLE-IS-SLEEP. DRIVES-ARE-DRIVERS (v7, supersedes DRIVES-FORBID-IDLE): standing questions, problems, commitments, ideas, interests and tensions are the DRIVERS of cognition and existence — a day arises because something pulls, never because a threshold forbids stillness. GATE (whether): at a day boundary, jobs queued -> work (v25: no work switch); else ANY standing drive + personal on -> a personal day may arise (personal->personal); else he rests between days inside personal. v22: the gate NEVER chooses sleep — sleep is his decision from maintenance signals or the operator's request (the v9 preemption clauses retired with the gate's sleep leg); personal off ends own time AWAKE (idle, contract v2 2026-11-09 §10.1). The gate consumes drive_pressure's STANDING counts (total_open > 0 — presence of pull, never a magnitude threshold); a STOPPED loop stays stopped regardless (liveness outranks drive). OFFER (which): the day cue surfaces from abstractmemory.alive_drives (trail + formation recency — the evolving memory state), act-frame handles (kind #tag date, no gist words — lexical self-confirmation is the mirror writing itself), ONE offer with the release clause in the cue text ('yours if it pulls, never owed'), rotation over the standing sets as the guaranteed slow channel so dormant drives get their day (never pure argmax over a self-reinforcing signal). Presence in a cue deposits NOTHING (presence != use — both ends pinned: memory's read is pure, runtime excludes cue handles from commit). The >20 floor (pressure_floor block below) is OBSERVABILITY ONLY — an operator alarm shape (pressure high AND no day arising), never a gate input. Owners: memory (drive_pressure + alive_drives, both shipped), runtime (day-gate consume + cue composition + the commit exclusion — ONE cue composer: alive_drives-fed offer replaces/merges the rotated standing_state_note, never stacks on it), gateway (serves counts on /cognition), entity app (renders standing pull as information, never an alarm; the fired-alarm shape waits on served day-history).

SLEEP-IS-A-DECISION (v22, supersedes v17 OPERATOR-SLEEP-IS-ABSOLUTE): sleep is entered ONLY by the operator's request or the entity's own decision from maintenance signals — never by a clock, a gate leg, a toggle or a grant expiry. It ends by itself when its maintenance is done, or by the operator's wake; a visit interrupts it. Sleep NEVER disarms the personal toggle and NEVER clears the work order (contract v2 2026-11-09 rulings 2-3, §4.3). v25 (contract v3 D2, operator 2026-11-09): from IDLE only, the operator's two Mind thresholds — sleep.after_hours (default 24) hours since his last completed maintenance pass, or sleep.after_events (default 500) new memories since it — let the gateway's idle sweep put him to sleep (kind self, sleep.reason names the threshold); that sleep returns to idle when its maintenance is done. No threshold ever applies in visit, work or personal.

NO-SLEEP-AFTER-SLEEP (v22, TARGET 19:11): there is no sleep->sleep edge — from sleep he goes to personal, work or visit. A visit's close back into the interrupted sleep is the same sleep (visit->sleep#visit_close), not a second one; idle between two sleeps never makes one legal (the gateway refuses sleep_now while asleep or when his last activity phase was sleep; the runtime gate refuses it from restart #3).

PERSONAL-OFF-NEVER-SLEEPS (v22, TARGET; root 1178): turning personal off ends own time with its current step finished and leaves him AWAKE and visitable (idle, or work when jobs are queued). No edge into sleep carries a grant cause; every edge into sleep is the operator's act, his own election, or a visit returning to the sleep it interrupted (visit_close, or crash_recovered when the visit's run was lost). v25: the idle thresholds' sleep is no grant cause either — it starts from idle on the operator's Mind settings, never because own time was revoked.

When an interruption ends, he returns to resume_to while its grant still stands; if the operator revoked it meanwhile he ends IDLE: awake and visitable (never asleep, PERSONAL-OFF-NEVER-SLEEPS). No edge into personal carries the entity's own election (self_elected is a sleep cause only). v25 (contract v3 D3): Stop REVOKES the grant (revoked_by kill_switch) and clears resume_to, and Resume lands IDLE — 'personal time is never given back during a resume'; own time returns only with the operator's next grant.
